question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

CYB 48 DZC 53 EAD 58 FBE 63 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ff8e405009a3f2574173763200ca048d55c5b40ddf12bf300a3cbe5d2534144.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The series follows a pattern where each cluster is formed by incrementing the alphabetical position of every letter by 1 and increasing the number part by 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbeb384900e97ded55faef6cbec3fcaa187144f833c7cfd1e9cd2624fdc44325.png] 

 

Therefore, the cluster that will replace the question mark is GCF 68.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
